_readme: Edit this file to change meats, flavours, sizes and prices. The server uses it to check and price every preorder, and the website reads it too.

customPrice._note: Used for custom sizes: base + perGram x grams. With these numbers 50 g = 50, 100 g = 80 and 150 g = 110, so custom sizes line up with the presets.

paymentNote: No payment online. Ed confirms your order by phone or message, and you pay on pickup or delivery.

flavours.name: Texas BBQ

flavours.name: Garlic Teriyaki
flavours.notes: Soy and roasted garlic in a sticky teriyaki glaze. Deep and savoury, no heat.
